$comment: Pack Rat profiles.json schema v2. Draft-07 style, restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mts supports (see that file's header). `characters` and `templates` are maps of objects; each entry's `resistCaps` (the player's per-resist cap overrides, paperdoll values, whole numbers 0-150 on the five resist keys only; app/vault-lib.mts's RESIST_CAP_LIMITS and resistCapsError hold the same rule) is checked field by field, and so is `excludeWeapons` (the weapon skills left out of the candidate pool: known skills only, the same list as app/vault-lib.mts's WEAPON_SKILLS, which excludeWeaponsError also holds to; the single `weaponSkill` it replaced is migrated on read by migrateProfiles), and every other field of an entry is left loose. A character entry is loosely {template?, floors?, softFloors?, weights?, floorBonus?, lockedSlots?, excludeTags?, excludeSkills?, allowOthersWorn?, allowGargoyle?, medOnly?, excludeWeapons?, resistCaps?, race?, strLimit?, caps?} (see app/vault-lib.mts and CONTRIBUTING.md's Templates section); a template entry is the same minus race/strLimit. additionalProperties is true throughout (a `_comment` key, and any field a newer client adds, must round-trip through PUT /api/profiles unharmed).
